scope: The historic Tripura Sundari brick sanctuary and connected west assembly hall in Matabari, Udaipur, based on the pre-redevelopment appearance.

references.filename: Tripura Sundari Temple or Tripureswari Temple.jpg

originalReview.notes: The photograph shows the red plaster wall, rounded brass-colored opening and warm wood door leaves. It is a tight photograph of the sanctuary threshold. EXIF DateTimeOriginal is October 22, 2019 and the file page gives its April 2020 modification date.

quallaSearch.notes: The sole published Qualla photo matches the named Wikimedia Commons upload byte for byte. The original uploader identifies it as own work and dedicates it to CC0. The photograph provides doorway details. Published written architectural descriptions provide the roof form and the exterior dimensions.
